text:
Which statement describes how the C–H bonds in methane gas in the atmosphere contribute to
global warming?
A
They absorb thermal energy from the Sun and emit some of this energy into space.
B
They absorb thermal energy from the Sun and emit all of this energy towards the Earth.
C
They absorb thermal energy from the Earth and emit all of this energy towards the Earth.
D
They absorb thermal energy from the Earth and emit some of this energy towards the Earth.

options.label: A
options.text: They absorb thermal energy from the Sun and emit some of this energy into space.

options.label: B
options.text: They absorb thermal energy from the Sun and emit all of this energy towards the Earth.

options.label: C
options.text: They absorb thermal energy from the Earth and emit all of this energy towards the Earth.

options.label: D
options.text: They absorb thermal energy from the Earth and emit some of this energy towards the Earth.
